description: Feature 3.5 bug registry — bugs found in Phase 1-4

bugs.scenario: No live Python environment available in this session — backend startup, actual HTTP requests, and live E2E execution blocked
bugs.expected: Backend starts, GET /health returns 200, all E2E flows execute
bugs.actual: Backend not started — no Python interpreter confirmed in this session
bugs.root_cause: No live Python runtime available in current session environment
bugs.fix_action: Run backend in a live Python environment
bugs.regression_test: Backend starts and health check passes
bugs.notes: This is not a code bug. All contract and architecture validations pass. The BLOCKER is environmental.

bugs.expected: Backend requirements.txt declares httpx if httpx is needed for testing
bugs.actual: httpx is declared in epic3/feature_3_2/backend/requirements.txt but not in 5.UNG_DUNG/5.1.backend_api/requirements.txt
bugs.root_cause: httpx is a testing dependency; backend runtime does not use httpx. Two parallel backend directories exist (5.UNG_DUNG and epic3). httpx is declared in epic3/feature_3_2/.
bugs.fix_action: Add httpx>=0.27.0 to 5.UNG_DUNG/5.1.backend_api/requirements.txt for testing completeness
bugs.fix_description: httpx>=0.27.0 added to backend requirements for testing compatibility
bugs.regression_test: httpx available after pip install -r requirements.txt

bugs.expected: Frontend directory has a requirements.txt declaring streamlit and httpx
bugs.root_cause: Frontend dependencies (streamlit, httpx) not declared in frontend directory
bugs.fix_action: Create requirements.txt in epic3/feature_3_3/frontend/ with streamlit>=1.30.0, httpx>=0.27.0
bugs.regression_test: pip install -r requirements.txt in frontend directory succeeds

notes: F35-BUG-001 is environmental (no live Python) — not fixable by code change. F35-BUG-002 is LOW and fixable. F35-BUG-003 is MEDIUM (no frontend requirements.txt).
